summary: The Wild Women of Chastity Gulch is a 1982 American made-for-television western romantic comedy directed by Philip Leacock. It stars Priscilla Barnes, Lee Horsley, Joan Collins, Donny Osmond, Morgan Brittany and Lisa Whelchel. Executive produced by Aaron Spelling, it premiered on ABC on October 31, 1982 and was later syndicated to cable television for rebroadcast.
one_line: A 1982 American made-for-television western romantic comedy directed by Philip Leacock and produced by Aaron Spelling for ABC.
